review.why: Pick the right architecture for an n8n workflow: webhook, API, database, AI agent, scheduled and batch patterns, with node choices, gotchas and a checklist.
review.summary: A pattern catalogue with a selection guide for six workflow shapes, shared building blocks (triggers, sources, native-first transforms, outputs, error handling), a four-gate lifecycle (validate, verify connections, test, activate), SplitInBatches and pagination rules, performance guidance and integration gotchas. Five pattern files cover webhooks, APIs, databases, AI agents and schedules.
strengths: Specific, checkable guidance: batchSize as a cost lever, loop output wiring, webhook data under body, Sheets append breaking formulas.
A lifecycle that insists validation passing is not enough and warns that tests fire real side effects.
Scheduled-task pattern with cron, timezone and common use cases (reports, sync, monitoring, cleanup, backup).
cautions: Written around the n8n-mcp tools (search_nodes, validate_workflow) and sibling skills of the same pack; it is much less useful without them.
Usage percentages in the statistics section carry no source.
SKILL.md read in full, the pattern files not read (one listed by headings); not run here. The scan flagged three documentation lines naming webhook.site as a testing service.
